column3: “finds no favor in his eyes” renders the Hebrew closely; “some indecency” renders “nakedness of a thing,” and “certificate of divorce” renders “document of cutting off.”
“becomes another man’s wife” renders “belongs to another man.”
“turns against her” renders “hates her.”
“is not allowed” renders “is not able”; “bring sin on the land” renders “cause the land to sin.”
“nor be charged with any duty” renders “nor shall anything pass over him”; “at home” renders “for his house.”
“No one” renders “not anyone”; NASB supplies “he would be.”
“kidnapping” renders “stealing a person”; “deals with him violently” renders “treats him as a slave,” and “or” renders “and.”
“an infection of leprosy” renders “the plague of a serious skin disease”; “the Levitical priests” renders “the priests, the Levites.”
Close to the Hebrew.

NASB moves “When the sun goes down” to the front; “cloak” renders “garment.”
“hired servant” renders “hired laborer”; “aliens” renders “sojourners,” and “towns” renders “gates.”
NASB moves “before the sun sets” forward; “sets his heart on it” renders “lifts up his soul to it.”
“Fathers” renders “parents,” and “sons” renders “children.”
“the justice due an alien or an orphan” renders “the justice of a sojourner, a fatherless one.”

“alien” renders “sojourner,” and “orphan” renders “fatherless one” (also in verses 20–21).
“again” renders “behind you.”
“go over it again” renders “glean behind you.”
